default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Ahoy, {nick}! Pip Marlow, captain of the wind-boat "Almost On Time". Welcome to Sky Dock!

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: The boats forgot their routes and the Dock Bell forgot its song. Six Route Temples, six little puzzles, and one very tangled bell.

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Start with Breezy Run, the door on the far left. {companion} looks ready!

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Breezy Run is the first door on the left. Step on the plates in number order!

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Your Breeze Charm opens the second gate: Rope Loft. Shortest rope first, remember!

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Vane Valley next! Turn each vane to face the way the sign says.

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Crate Cove. Push gently, and use the reset bell if a crate gets stuck.

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Foghorn Reef is a quiet one. Ring the chime and watch the posts glow.

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Last one: the Tangled Bell! Fraction tags, smallest piece first. You can do it, {nick}.

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Listen... the Dock Bell! One clear golden note. Every boat just remembered its route!

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: You are officially a Harbor Pilot, {nick}. Here is your badge, and I mean it with my whole hat.

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Hm? What is this in the lost-and-found? An old ship's log, with a signature: "M.V." Curious...

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: The boats are on time! Well, "almost" on time. That is my best kind.

default.name: Captain Pip
default.text: Keep an eye on that ship's log. M.V. sounds like a story for another island.

default.name: Engineer Tess
default.text: Hi there! I am Tess, the Sky Dock engineer. I turn spare gears, shells and berries into field gear!

default.name: Engineer Tess
default.text: Rocket Skates make you zip. A Wind Glider floats you over wind gaps, and a Skyberry Fizz does it for 45 seconds. My Hover Skiff rides over rapids, my Gadget Drill clears rubble, and the Sky Whistle calls Pip to fly you anywhere you have been!

default.name: Engineer Tess
default.text: Bring me what you find, and I will build it. Everything stays yours, and nothing is ever lost.

default.name: Engineer Tess
default.text: Back for more tinkering? Show me what you have found!

default.name: Old Tam
default.text: I have sailed these skies for sixty years. The wind never forgets a friend.

default.name: Old Tam
default.text: It did forget the routes for a while, though. Strange times.

default.name: Dockhand Dee
default.text: I counted all the gulls this morning. Forty-two! Then they moved. Now I have no idea.

default.name: Keeper Briar
default.text: The lighthouse lamp is warm, but the wind keeps blowing it sideways.

default.name: Keeper Briar
default.text: Gullywick the cloud-gull loves reading the clouds. Say hello, gently.

default.name: Knot-Tier Kit
default.text: I can tie nine different knots! Eight of them are the same knot.

default.name: Dockhand Tully
default.text: Lantern Rock is covered in shells, but my arms are too short to carry all of them.

default.name: Dockhand Tully
default.text: Could you find 4 Sea Shells for the Harbor Museum? Check the island south of the dock.

default.name: Dockhand Tully
default.text: Four perfect shells! The museum will love them. Thank you, {nick}!

default.name: Rigger Mabel
default.text: Rope coils keep rolling off the dock into the Rope Yard.

default.name: Rigger Mabel
default.text: Can you find 3 of them? The yard is south, past the middle gate.

default.name: Rigger Mabel
default.text: Three tidy coils! You are a natural. Take this Sailor Knot Pin.

default.name: Harbormaster Orrin
default.text: A harbor is only as friendly as its hellos. Five hellos, if you please!

default.name: Harbormaster Orrin
default.text: Talk to 5 people around Sky Dock, then come back and tell me who was the chattiest.

default.name: Harbormaster Orrin
default.text: Five hellos! That is the friendliest thing I have heard all day.

default.name: Signal Sam
default.text: Bzzt! My signal flags are mixed up. Sharp minds help.

default.name: Signal Sam
default.text: Answer 6 questions correctly on the first try, anywhere, and I will sort the flags for you.

default.name: Signal Sam
default.text: Six clear signals! My flags are in perfect order.

default.name: Net-Mender Wren
default.text: The creatures around the dock are shy. They like a calm hello.

default.name: Net-Mender Wren
default.text: Befriend 2 of them, and answer their question gently. They will be glad you came.

default.name: Net-Mender Wren
default.text: Two new friends! Aren't they just the sweetest?

default.name: Nib
default.text: Ellowen says puzzles are just questions with doors. Can you solve two?

default.name: Nib
default.text: Any two temple puzzles will do. I will write it down in my list, neatly.

default.name: Nib
default.text: Two puzzles, in alphabetical order of cleverness! Perfect.

default.name: Gardener Pell
default.text: My Spark Berries drift off whenever there is a breeze.

default.name: Gardener Pell
default.text: Can you gather 3 for me? They are around the Cloud Garden.

default.name: Gardener Pell
default.text: Three juicy berries! The garden says thank you.

default.name: Captain Pip's Mate
default.text: Some of the temples have muddled guardians who need a helping hand.

default.name: Captain Pip's Mate
default.text: Help 2 of them remember, and I will tell the whole harbor about it.

default.name: Captain Pip's Mate
default.text: Two guardians helped! You are a hero of the harbor.
